items.text: Add the date 2026-11-12: “EU ETS provisional agreement reached on boosting free carbon allowances”
items.reason: The Council and European Parliament reached a provisional agreement on 12 November 2026 to boost free carbon allowances for energy-intensive industries.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims Commission confirms withdrawal of the proposal”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed its decision to scrap and withdraw the Green Claims Directive proposal.

items.text: New status text: “Withdrawn. The European Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal of the proposal in November 2026, after negotiations were stalled in June 2025.”
items.reason: Updates status to reflect the official scrapping/withdrawal of the Green Claims Directive proposal by the Commission in November 2026.
